title: A metaphor identification procedure for specialized corpora (MIPspec): the case of promotional wine-tasting discourse
core_idea: Propose MIPspec, a nine-step procedure for identifying metaphors in specialized texts that builds on MIP and MIPVU and augments them with concept maps during conceptual exploration (step 2) and conceptual redefinition (step 9), illustrated via promotional wine-tasting discourse.
tldr: Introduce MIPspec, an expanded nine-step metaphor identification method for specialized corpora that integrates concept maps into key conceptual steps, demonstrated on promotional wine-tasting discourse.
